newsitem.title: USA: LILCO nears restoring power to 44,000 users.
newsitem.headline: LILCO nears restoring power to 44,000 users.

text.p: Long Island Lighting Co (LILCO) is close to restoring power to all 44,000 customers whose electricity service was disrupted by a heavy rainstorm Tuesday evening, the company said Wednesday.
"Right now, we have 730 (customers) out," said company spokeswoman April Dubison, adding the utility hoped to return electricity to those remaining customers, mainly in Suffolk County, later today.
Heavy rain and strong winds overnight knocked down local power lines to the affected customers, she said.
LILCO deliveries power to one million customers living on Long Island, N.Y.
